title: Great tour of Seville Cathedral
text:
Meet up instructions were correct and clear. Audio equipment provided by Roberto worked very well.  He has a lot of knowledge about the cathedral and loves to share it.  The cathedral is very impressive, you could spend days exploring it, and I'm sure Roberto would have interesting stories about every single detail.  He shares a lot of interesting information during the tour.
The trip to the top of the tower is physically demanding (35 ramps), in my opinion the interior of the cathedral is more rewarding with less effort.
author: John_S

title: You should do this!
text: A super insightful and delightful private tour.  Carlos was fantastic.  Very knowledgeable and passionate.
author: Douglas_S

title: Awesome Tour
text:
We were asked to change our start time, which wasn't an issue for us. When we arrived at the meeting point, we were lucky enough to have a private tour.  Skipping the line was terrific and saved so much time.

Our guide, Roberto, was incredibly knowledgeable. He took us to all of the major highlights in the massive cathedral and explained both historical facts and local folklore. Such an incredible amount of art and artifacts reside in this impressive building. We felt like we learned a lot about the cathedral and its significance in Seville.

title: Great tour and perfect lengt!
text: Great tour! Our guide was fantastic and super kind.  One in our party didn’t know shoulders had to be covered and he instantly purchased a shawl for her.  Would highly recommend this tour!

title: Excellent Seville Cathedral Guide and Tour
text: Our guide, Robert, was excellent. He met us and our group precisely where we were told.  Audio hearing aid was great.   Robert is an excellent guide.  Clearly knowledgeable and passionate about his work.  All he said was relevant,  to the point,  and instructive.  His English was perfect.  We booked this tour last minute and well worth it.  Zero waiting to enter and exactly as tour description stated.

title: Great commentary, Robert was great!
